recipes.name: Baklava
recipes.description: Thin pastry layered with walnuts and finished with lemon syrup.
instructions: Layer half the phyllo in a buttered tray, brushing each sheet lightly with butter
spread walnuts and cover with remaining sheets, buttering each
Cut into diamonds before baking
bake at 180 C until deep golden, about 40 minutes
Boil sugar and water 8 minutes, add lemon and cool
pour cool syrup over hot pastry
rest several hours.
recipes.sides: Serve in small pieces with coffee.
recipes.substitutions: Use pistachios or almonds.
recipes.storage: Store covered in a cool dry place for 4 days.
recipes.safety: Check walnut allergies; cool syrup before pouring.

recipes.name: Bamija
recipes.description: Tender beef and okra simmered with tomato, onion and lemon.
instructions: Brown beef in oil
add onion and cook until soft
Add tomatoes and stock
cover and simmer until beef is nearly tender
Add okra and lemon juice
simmer gently until okra is tender and broth lightly thickened
season.
recipes.sides: Serve with rice or bread.
recipes.substitutions: Use frozen okra and add directly to stew.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate promptly up to 3 days; reheat until steaming.
recipes.safety: Cook beef thoroughly and chill leftovers promptly.

recipes.name: Banjalucki cevapi
recipes.description: Beef and lamb mince shaped as linked grill portions and served in flatbread.
instructions: Mix meats with salt, baking soda and water
knead until tacky
chill at least 2 hours
Press into flat connected portions or form short sausages
Grill over medium-high heat, turning until browned and fully cooked
separate portions and serve.
recipes.sides: Serve with somun, chopped onion and yogurt.
recipes.substitutions: Use all beef if lamb is not wanted.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate raw mixture up to 24 hours; cooked leftovers up to 2 days.
recipes.safety: Cook mince thoroughly and use separate raw-meat utensils.

recipes.name: Begova corba
recipes.description: A rich chicken soup thickened with okra, root vegetables and a light flour roux.
instructions: Simmer chicken with carrot, celeriac and onion in stock until cooked
remove chicken and strain broth
Dice vegetables and chicken
return to broth and add okra
Melt butter, stir in flour for one minute, whisk in broth and simmer until lightly thickened
season and finish with parsley.
recipes.sides: Serve hot with bread and lemon.
recipes.substitutions: Use turkey and frozen okra if needed.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate promptly up to 2 days; reheat until steaming.
recipes.safety: Cook chicken through and keep soup chilled.

recipes.name: Bosanska kafa
recipes.description: Finely ground coffee brewed in a small pot and poured with its foam into a small cup.
instructions: Bring water to a boil in a small pot
remove from heat and stir in coffee
Return briefly to low heat until foam rises, without boiling over
Rest 1 minute for grounds to settle
Pour slowly into small cups, sharing foam evenly.
recipes.sides: Serve with sugar cubes or lokum.
recipes.substitutions: Adjust coffee amount to taste.
recipes.storage: Brew fresh for each serving.
recipes.safety: Serve hot carefully; keep pot handle turned away from edge.

recipes.name: Bosanski lonac
recipes.englishName: Bosnian layered meat and vegetable stew
recipes.description: Slow-cooked layers of beef, cabbage and seasonal vegetables in their own broth.
instructions: Cut vegetables into large pieces and beef into cubes
Layer beef and vegetables in a heavy pot, seasoning lightly between layers
Add bay and stock
cover tightly and cook very gently until beef and vegetables are tender, about 2 hours
stir carefully before serving.
recipes.sides: Serve with bread and pickled vegetables.
recipes.substitutions: Use lamb or add green beans in season.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate promptly up to 3 days; reheat until bubbling.
recipes.safety: Cook beef thoroughly and cool leftovers quickly.

recipes.name: Burek
recipes.description: Thin pastry layered with a gently seasoned beef and onion filling, baked until crisp.
instructions: Cook onion in oil until soft
add beef and cook until browned and liquid evaporates
season and cool
Brush pastry sheets lightly with oil
layer several sheets and spread a thin line of filling along one edge
Roll into a long coil and arrange in a greased round pan
Repeat to fill pan
drizzle with water and oil
Bake at 190 C until golden and crisp.
recipes.sides: Serve with plain yogurt.
recipes.substitutions: Use minced lamb or a spinach filling for a different pita style.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate within 2 hours up to 2 days; reheat in oven.
recipes.safety: Cook minced beef fully and keep raw pastry surfaces clean.

recipes.name: Cupavci
recipes.description: Sponge cake cubes dipped in chocolate sauce and rolled in coconut.
instructions: Beat eggs and sugar until pale
fold in flour and baking powder
Bake in a lined 20 cm tin at 180 C until set
cool and cut into cubes
Warm milk, butter and chocolate until smooth
Dip cubes quickly in sauce and roll in coconut
set on rack.
recipes.sides: Serve with coffee.
recipes.substitutions: Use dark or milk chocolate to taste.
recipes.storage: Keep covered up to 3 days; refrigerate in warm conditions.
recipes.safety: Cool cake fully before dipping; keep dairy sauce refrigerated if storing.

recipes.name: Hurmasice
recipes.description: Soft baked biscuits soaked in lemon syrup, a common home sweet for coffee.
instructions: Boil syrup sugar and water 8 minutes
add lemon juice and cool
Cream butter and sugar
beat in egg
mix in flour and baking powder to make soft dough
Shape small ovals and score tops
bake at 180 C until pale golden
Pour cool syrup over hot biscuits and leave to absorb.
recipes.sides: Serve at room temperature with coffee.
recipes.substitutions: Use orange peel in syrup.
recipes.storage: Store covered in a cool place for 3 days.
recipes.safety: Cool syrup before pouring and store sweets covered.

recipes.name: Janjetina ispod saca
recipes.description: Lamb and potatoes roasted together under a covered pot until tender and browned.
instructions: Heat oven to 170 C
season lamb with salt, pepper and rosemary
Brown lamb briefly in a heavy casserole
Add potatoes, onions, garlic and stock
cover tightly and roast until lamb is tender, about 2 hours
Uncover for final 20 minutes to brown
rest before serving.
recipes.sides: Serve with salad and flatbread.
recipes.substitutions: Use beef chuck and extend braising time.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate within 2 hours up to 3 days; reheat until hot.
recipes.safety: Cook lamb until tender and keep raw meat separate.

recipes.name: Japrak
recipes.description: Vine leaves wrapped around a savoury rice and minced meat filling and simmered with lemon.
instructions: Rinse preserved leaves
mix beef, rinsed rice, onion, parsley, pepper and salt
Place a small spoon of filling on each leaf
fold sides and roll tightly
Arrange rolls seam-down in a pot
cover with stock and lemon slices
weigh down with a plate
simmer gently until rice and meat are cooked, about 50 minutes.
recipes.sides: Serve with yogurt or sour cream.
recipes.substitutions: Use lamb mince or make rice-only rolls.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate within 2 hours up to 3 days; reheat gently.
recipes.safety: Cook rice and minced meat filling fully.

recipes.name: Japrak od poriluka
recipes.description: Leek leaves wrapped around a seasoned beef and rice filling and braised in stock.
instructions: Separate leek leaves and blanch briefly until flexible
mix beef with rinsed rice, onion, parsley and seasoning
Place filling on leek leaves, fold sides and roll
Arrange tightly in pot
mix stock with tomato paste and pour over
simmer covered until rice and meat are cooked, about 40 minutes.
recipes.sides: Serve with yogurt.
recipes.substitutions: Use cabbage leaves if leeks are too small.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate promptly up to 2 days; reheat until steaming.
recipes.safety: Cook minced beef and rice completely.

recipes.name: Klepe
recipes.description: Small pasta parcels filled with seasoned meat, boiled and topped with garlicky yogurt.
instructions: Mix flour, egg, water and salt into a firm dough
knead and rest covered 20 minutes
Mix beef with onion and pepper
Roll dough thin and cut squares
add a little filling, fold and seal edges
Boil dumplings gently until they float and pasta is tender
mix yogurt with crushed garlic and spoon over.
recipes.sides: Finish with melted butter and paprika.
recipes.substitutions: Use lamb or finely chopped mushrooms.
recipes.storage: Serve immediately; refrigerate cooked dumplings up to 2 days.
recipes.safety: Cook beef filling fully; keep yogurt chilled until serving.

recipes.name: Klepe sa krompirom
recipes.description: Soft pasta dumplings filled with seasoned potato and served with butter and yogurt.
instructions: Make firm pasta dough with flour, egg, water and salt
rest covered 20 minutes
Cook onion in butter until golden
mix into mashed potato with pepper
Roll dough thin, cut squares and add potato filling
seal into parcels
Boil gently until pasta is tender and dumplings float
serve with yogurt.
recipes.sides: Sprinkle with paprika or browned butter.
recipes.substitutions: Use cheese mixed into the potato.
recipes.storage: Best fresh; refrigerate cooked dumplings up to 2 days.
recipes.safety: Cook dough fully and keep yogurt chilled until serving.

recipes.name: Krompirusa
recipes.description: Thin pastry spiralled around grated potato, onion and pepper filling.
instructions: Squeeze excess liquid from grated potato
mix with onion, salt and pepper
Brush pastry lightly with oil
spread potato filling in a narrow line and roll
Coil rolls into an oiled pan
mix water and remaining oil, drizzle over top
Bake at 190 C until crisp and golden, about 35 to 40 minutes.
recipes.sides: Serve hot with yogurt.
recipes.substitutions: Use ready-made yufka for easier handling.
recipes.storage: Best fresh; refrigerate leftovers up to 2 days and reheat in oven.
recipes.safety: Keep raw potato filling clean and cook pastry through.

recipes.name: Pilav
recipes.description: Rice simmered with onion and stock until fluffy, often served with meat or vegetables.
instructions: Rinse rice until water runs mostly clear
Cook onion in butter until soft
Stir rice through butter until grains look glossy
add hot stock and bay
cover and simmer low until liquid is absorbed
rest 5 minutes
fluff with fork and add parsley.
recipes.sides: Serve with roast chicken, stews or yogurt.
recipes.substitutions: Use vegetable stock and olive oil.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate quickly and use within 1 day; reheat once.
recipes.safety: Cool cooked rice quickly and refrigerate within 1 hour.

recipes.name: Pita sa lukom
recipes.description: Baked filo pie filled with soft onions, yogurt and egg for a savoury meal.
instructions: Cook onions slowly in oil until soft and sweet
cool slightly
Whisk eggs, yogurt and pepper
stir through onions
Layer pastry sheets in oiled dish, brushing lightly
add filling and cover with remaining sheets
Cut into portions and bake at 190 C until golden and set.
recipes.sides: Serve with salad or yogurt.
recipes.substitutions: Add spinach or leeks to the filling.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate promptly up to 2 days; reheat in oven.
recipes.safety: Cook egg filling fully and keep dairy chilled before baking.

recipes.name: Proja
recipes.description: A simple baked cornmeal bread with yogurt and salty cheese.
instructions: Heat oven to 190 C and grease a small baking tin
Whisk eggs, yogurt and oil
fold in cornmeal, flour and baking powder
Fold in cheese and pour into tin
Bake 25 to 30 minutes until set and golden
cool slightly before slicing.
recipes.sides: Serve with soup, yogurt or cured meat.
recipes.substitutions: Use feta for the white cheese.
recipes.storage: Store covered at room temperature for 1 day or refrigerate for 3 days.
recipes.safety: Bake until centre is set; refrigerate if keeping longer.

recipes.name: Punjena paprika
recipes.description: Bell peppers filled with minced meat and rice, gently cooked in tomato sauce.
instructions: Mix beef with rinsed rice, diced onion, paprika, salt and pepper
Trim pepper tops and remove seeds
fill loosely
Stand peppers in a pot
add tomatoes and stock, cover and simmer gently until filling is cooked and peppers tender
remove peppers and reduce sauce slightly.
recipes.sides: Serve with mashed potato or bread.
recipes.substitutions: Use lentils and cooked rice for a meat-free filling.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate promptly up to 3 days; reheat until steaming.
recipes.safety: Cook minced meat and rice fully; do not overfill peppers.

recipes.name: Pura
recipes.description: Cornmeal stirred into salted water until smooth and served with dairy or stew.
instructions: Bring salted water to a boil
Whisk cornmeal in slowly to prevent lumps
Lower heat and stir often until thick and cooked, 20 to 25 minutes
Stir in butter and serve with sour cream.
recipes.sides: Serve alongside stews or cheese.
recipes.substitutions: Use milk for a creamier porridge.
recipes.storage: Best fresh; refrigerate leftovers and reheat with water.
recipes.safety: Stir carefully to avoid hot splashes.

recipes.name: Rahat lokum
recipes.description: Small fragrant cubes of starch-thickened sugar syrup dusted with icing sugar.
instructions: Boil sugar, half the water and lemon juice until syrup reaches soft-ball stage
Mix cornflour with remaining cold water
whisk into syrup gradually
Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until very thick and translucent
Stir in rose water, pour into a lined tin and leave overnight
cut and dust with icing sugar.
recipes.sides: Serve with Bosnian coffee.
recipes.substitutions: Use orange blossom water instead of rose.
recipes.storage: Store airtight in a cool dry place for several days.
recipes.safety: Hot sugar syrup causes severe burns; keep children away.

recipes.name: Sarajevski cevapi
recipes.description: Small simply seasoned beef sausages grilled and served with flatbread and chopped onion.
instructions: Mix beef with salt, baking soda, sparkling water and grated onion
knead until tacky
Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours
Shape into short finger-sized sausages
Grill or pan-grill, turning until browned and cooked through.
recipes.sides: Serve in somun with chopped onion and yogurt.
recipes.substitutions: Use a beef and lamb blend; keep seasoning restrained.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate raw mix up to 24 hours; cooked leftovers use within 2 days.
recipes.safety: Cook minced meat through the centre; avoid reusing raw-meat plates.

recipes.name: Sarma
recipes.englishName: Cabbage rolls with meat and rice
recipes.description: Minced meat and rice rolled in sour cabbage leaves and slowly braised.
instructions: Rinse cabbage leaves if very salty
mix beef, rinsed rice, onion, paprika and pepper
Place filling on each leaf and roll tightly, folding in sides
Layer rolls with smoked beef in a heavy pot
add stock to cover
simmer partly covered until rice and meat are cooked and cabbage tender, about 90 minutes.
recipes.sides: Serve with bread and yogurt.
recipes.substitutions: Use fresh blanched cabbage with lemon if sour leaves are unavailable.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate promptly up to 3 days; reheat until hot throughout.
recipes.safety: Cook filling fully and refrigerate leftovers quickly.

recipes.name: Satara
recipes.description: Slow-cooked peppers, tomatoes and onions, sometimes enriched with eggs.
instructions: Cook onion in oil until soft
Add peppers and cook covered 10 minutes until beginning to soften
Stir in tomatoes and simmer uncovered until thick and tender
If using eggs, make wells and cover until whites set
finish with parsley.
recipes.sides: Serve with flatbread or polenta.
recipes.substitutions: Omit eggs for a vegan side dish.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate vegetables up to 3 days; reheat thoroughly.
recipes.safety: Cook eggs until whites are fully set.

recipes.name: Sirnica
recipes.description: Layered pastry filled with a tangy mixture of fresh cheese and cream.
instructions: Whisk cheese, cream and eggs until combined
Grease baking dish
layer half the pastry, brushing lightly with oil
Spread filling evenly and cover with remaining pastry
Cut into portions
pour sparkling water and remaining oil over top
Bake at 190 C until puffed and golden.
recipes.sides: Serve warm with yogurt.
recipes.substitutions: Use ricotta drained well and plain yogurt.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate promptly up to 2 days; reheat until hot.
recipes.safety: Keep dairy filling refrigerated before baking and cook egg mixture through.

recipes.name: Sogan dolma
recipes.description: Soft onion layers filled with seasoned minced meat and rice, braised in tomato broth.
instructions: Peel onions and boil 10 minutes until layers loosen
cool slightly and separate large outer layers
Mix beef, rinsed rice, parsley, salt and pepper
Fill onion layers and roll into parcels
Arrange snugly in a casserole
whisk tomato paste into stock and pour over
Cover and simmer gently until rice and meat cook, about 45 minutes.
recipes.sides: Serve with sour cream or yogurt.
recipes.substitutions: Use lamb mince; keep parcels small for even cooking.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate promptly up to 2 days; reheat until steaming.
recipes.safety: Cook minced meat and rice completely through.

recipes.name: Tarhana
recipes.description: A tangy soup of tarhana dough cooked with stock and finished with yogurt.
instructions: Warm butter and stir in tomato paste
Add stock gradually, then whisk in dried tarhana
simmer gently, stirring until softened and soup thickens
Temper yogurt with a ladle of hot soup and stir back in off heat
finish with mint.
recipes.sides: Serve with bread.
recipes.substitutions: Use kefir or sour cream in place of yogurt.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate promptly up to 2 days; reheat gently.
recipes.safety: Temper dairy and avoid leaving soup warm for extended periods.

recipes.name: Tufahije
recipes.description: Apples poached until tender, filled with walnuts and served with whipped cream.
instructions: Core apples without piercing bases
Poach gently in water with sugar and lemon until tender but intact
Lift out and cool
reduce poaching syrup slightly
Fill centres with walnuts and a little syrup
Serve chilled or at room temperature with whipped cream.
recipes.sides: Top with extra walnuts.
recipes.substitutions: Use almonds or hazelnuts.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate apples covered up to 2 days; add cream at serving.
recipes.safety: Keep cream chilled and use clean utensils.

recipes.name: Ustipci
recipes.description: Small savoury yeast dough pieces fried until golden, eaten with cheese or jam.
instructions: Mix flour, yeast, sugar, salt and warm water into a soft dough
cover and rise until doubled
Wet hands and pinch off small pieces
Heat shallow oil to about 175 C
fry in batches, turning until golden and cooked through
drain on a rack.
recipes.sides: Serve with kajmak, cheese, honey or jam.
recipes.substitutions: Use half wholemeal flour for a heartier dough.
recipes.storage: Best fresh; store leftovers covered and use within a day.
recipes.safety: Use care with hot oil and fry dough through the centre.

recipes.name: Zeljanica
recipes.description: Phyllo pie filled with spinach, fresh cheese and egg, baked until crisp.
instructions: Chop spinach and mix with cheese, eggs, yogurt and salt
Brush pastry lightly with oil and layer half into a baking dish
Spread filling and cover with remaining sheets
Cut into portions and drizzle with remaining oil
Bake at 190 C until crisp and filling set.
recipes.sides: Serve with plain yogurt.
recipes.substitutions: Use chard or nettles instead of spinach.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate within 2 hours up to 2 days; reheat until hot.
recipes.safety: Cook egg filling fully and keep dairy chilled before baking.
